_metadata.description: EU and Germany international student trends - time series and breakdowns

sources.wissenschaft_weltoffen: DAAD/DZHW Wissenschaft weltoffen 2024 report and 2025 press releases
sources.eurostat: Eurostat Learning Mobility Statistics (2023 data, educ_uoe_mobs01 table)
sources.icef: ICEF Monitor Dec 2025: 'There are now more than 400,000 international students in Germany'
sources.sevis: DHS SEVP SEVIS Data Mapping Tool (for EU students in US)

notes: Germany data uses winter semester (WS) as reference. WS 2023/24 starts Oct 2023.
Germany distinguishes Bildungsauslaender (international) from Bildungsinlaender (resident foreign). Totals here are ALL foreign students unless noted.
Eurostat 2023 data is the most recent available (published Aug 2025).
Some country-level Germany data points are approximate (~) where exact figures were not available in source text.

germany_total_international_students._unit: total foreign students enrolled (winter semester), Bildungsauslaender + Bildungsinlaender

germany_bildungsauslaender_only._unit: international students who obtained HE entrance qualification abroad (winter semester)
germany_bildungsauslaender_only._note: This is the more comparable 'international student' metric

germany_new_international_enrollments._unit: first-time enrollments of international students (winter semester)

germany_top_countries_2024_25_preliminar._source: DAAD press release Dec 2025 / ICEF Monitor

eu_total_international_students._unit: students from abroad in EU tertiary education

eu_highest_foreign_share_2023._unit: % of tertiary students who are from abroad

eu_countries_students_in_us_sevis_mar202._unit: active F-1/M-1 records in the US
